guidance: Record only work that actually happened. Never fabricate progress. Absence of a blocker report is not confirmation that there are no blockers.

outline.title: Log Context
outline.guidance: Name who this log covers and how often entries are added. Prefer content in the children.

children.title: Team
children.guidance: List the members who report in this log. Use real names or handles; do not invent people.

children.title: Cadence
children.guidance: State how often entries are added (daily, twice weekly, sprint). Do not treat this as a project plan.

outline.title: Standup Entries
outline.guidance: Append dated entries in chronological order. Prefer content in the children. Do not rewrite past entries.

children.title: Standup Entry
children.guidance: Title each instance `<YYYY-MM-DD> — <Member>`. Do not title it "Standup Entry".

children.title: Completed
children.guidance: List work that actually finished since the last entry. Do not list in-progress work as done.

children.title: Next
children.guidance: List the concrete work this member will do next. Name artifacts or tickets, not vague intent.

children.title: Blockers
children.guidance: Name anything stopping progress, or omit this node. Leaving it out does not mean there are no blockers.

children.title: Help and Decisions
children.guidance: Record asks for help and decisions made in this standup. Omit if none.
